settings.hero_desc: A scale model of a solar farm - rows of photovoltaic panels around a central facility on a branded, LED-lit base. The clearest way to present a renewable-energy project to investors and stakeholders.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your site layout, branding, scale and lit base
settings.s1_body: A solar project is impressive in person but hard to convey on paper. This model lays out the panel array and central facility to scale on a branded, lit base, so investors and stakeholders grasp the scale and layout instantly. Built from your site plan, it's a powerful centrepiece for pitches, exhibitions and project handovers.
settings.case_body: Built to present a solar project, this lit model gave the team a tangible centrepiece - investors and partners could see the full array and facility, understanding the scale far faster than from a map.
settings.case_quote: It conveyed the scale of our project instantly. A standout piece at the exhibition.
settings.prov_p: A solar farm's impact is in its scale. A model lets investors and stakeholders see that scale - and the project's ambition - in a single glance.
